notes: Fix Android keyboard not reopening after a chip tap. The chip-tap dismissal trick sets readonly + inputmode='none' on the input to force the keyboard down, then clears them on a 250 ms timer. If you tapped the input within that window, Android decided 'no keyboard' at focus-time and never re-checked. Now any pointerdown / touchstart / mousedown on the input proactively clears those attributes before the focus event fires, so the keyboard reopens reliably.
